acceptance.assertion: The locale resolver has a tested, documented context-sensitive priority contract: an explicit locale URL or deep link determines the current navigation and is never automatically overridden; on a neutral entry surface a locally stored manual UI-language choice wins; in Automatic mode the first supported entry from navigator.languages is used; unsupported or unavailable preferences fall back to English; and a user-activated language switch updates the stored choice.

The language control exposes an accessible Automatic – device language option alongside English and German, supports keyboard and assistive technology, clearly indicates the effective language and does not require location permission.

Manual and Automatic choices persist locally without cookies, accounts or network transmission; unavailable, blocked or corrupt storage fails safely without breaking the page or causing redirect loops.

Locale switches preserve applicable query parameters and URL fragments, do not overwrite an explicit shared locale URL merely because a different preference is stored, and never loop between English and German surfaces.

Changing UI language does not silently alter the catalogue content-language filter, country selection, proximity origin, radius, map position or other discovery state; UI language, content language and regional relevance remain separate axes.

Browser language matching handles ordered, case-insensitive BCP 47 tags including region and script subtags, chooses only supported UI locales and has regression coverage for de-DE, en-GB, mixed preference lists and unsupported languages.

Canonical generators, source assets, German and English public pages and the immutable release tree contain the same locale-selection contract with content-version references regenerated deterministically.

The exact implementation heads pass focused JavaScript and Python i18n tests, full repository validation, responsive browser smoke, diff-bound self-review and all required GitHub checks; the complete diff is internally reviewed while external diff artifacts are optional under the later user-approved Commonworld contract, followed by exact-SHA Pages and production readback.

approval.note: The user explicitly requested implementation through Grabowski. Work must start only after T032 is terminal and its overlapping i18n, generated-page, assets, browser and publication surfaces are released.

goal: Make Commonworld choose its user-interface language predictably and privately: preserve an explicit local user choice, honor an explicitly selected locale surface, otherwise use the ordered browser/device language preferences and fall back to English, without deriving UI language from geolocation or coupling it to content-language and regional discovery filters.

permission to use geolocation for UI-language inference
account-wide synchronization without a future account contract

priority-contract.summary: The resolver gives explicit ui_lang and explicit locale surfaces authority, uses stored choice only on neutral entry, resolves Automatic from ordered navigator.languages and falls back to English.

accessible-automatic-mode.summary: English and German controls expose Automatic – device language, reflect the effective language through an aria-live status and retain keyboard-native link behavior without requesting geolocation.

safe-local-persistence.summary: Only commonworld.ui-locale is stored locally; blocked, absent and corrupt storage are caught and covered by regression tests without rendering failure or redirect loops.

url-state-preserved.summary: Locale navigation copies the full query and fragment, overwrites only ui_lang, respects an explicitly shared locale and avoids same-URL replacement loops.

language-axes-separated.summary: The public browser regression proves that switching interface language preserves the independent catalogue language filter and the remaining discovery URL state.

locale-tag-robustness.summary: Case-insensitive BCP 47 primary-tag matching covers de-DE, en-GB, script/region forms, ordered mixed preferences and unsupported-language fallback.

generated-release-parity.summary: Canonical generators, source assets, English/German index, method and proposal pages and immutable release f08b1db195874a2a130c share the version-bound locale contract.

exact-head-closeout.summary: PR heads 6968cf59d5a44b15f59bff4a2d11c299018bd6e8 and 52a4516ae6d7b4cc3038e52de41650ba92daeba5 passed required validation and CodeQL; combined implementation range ca43b6eaec626d3d8b10fcbbc07fcccd6dea07a7..bff413c7b390dfe0657f13238ca0959231c06ade passed diff check and self-review. Current main 16b4abf471dff7c67205add7a6587e8a824c5661 freshly passed make validate and browser smoke, and its Validate, Pages, CodeQL and Production-Readback runs are successful. External diff publication is optional under PR #166.

review.self_review: PASS after direct inspection of resolver, canonical generators, generated pages, release assets and regression tests; no remaining material finding; independence not claimed

local_validation.public_browser_smoke: PASS; locale preference, explicit URL authority, discovery-state preservation, iPad portrait and iPad landscape included

rollback.strategy: Revert the locale resolver, persistence hook, generated language controls, generated pages, release artifacts and their tests together; regenerate content-version bindings and verify that the previous static English/German links work without redirect or storage side effects.
